issue.title: Retire tool_run_escalation
issue.description: An agent's `sase tool run` under a provider ceiling starts the run detached, waits within the ceiling budget, and escalates to `sase monitor start -J` instead of being killed; `--detach`, `-J/--join`, and ceiling-bounded `sase tool wait`/`show -F` are available.

task_type_fields.remove_when: The sase-17g epic's final phase lands; it deletes the Off branch and closes this bead.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: Agent `sase tool run` stays a plain inline run, `--detach` and `-J/--join` are refused as not enabled, and `sase tool wait`/`show -F` ignore the provider ceiling.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: An agent's `sase tool run` under a provider ceiling starts the run detached, waits within the ceiling budget, and escalates to `sase monitor start -J` instead of being killed; `--detach`, `-J/--join`, and ceiling-bounded `sase tool wait`/`show -F` are available.

payload.entry: Removed tool_run_escalation in phase sase-1cx.7: deleted all Off branches (detach -d gate, sync_wait_budget gate, inline-escalation gate, monitor -J gate), removed the registry entry and schema block, deleted flag-off tests and harness flag matrix; On behavior is now unconditional.

payload.description: flag bead for tool_run_escalation removal in phase 7
